description: git and gh. Patterns are POSIX ERE (no \s, use [[:space:]]). Each rule is matched against ONE command of the line, both as written and after normalisation of the command word (sudo, env, command, VAR=, absolute paths, a leading parenthesis, git -C/-c, the body of sh -c), see hooks/lib/tier-lookup.sh.

rules._comment: Destructive push: --force in all its forms, a +refspec, combined short flags that contain f or d (-fu), --mirror, --delete or a :branch refspec.

Push to main or master. The branch must follow a separator ([[:space:]/:+]) so that 'origin main', 'HEAD:main' and 'refs/heads/main' fire, and branch names that end in 'main' (update-domain) do not. A bare `git push` while on main is NOT caught: protect main on the server too.

Every PR merge, whatever its base branch. The hook does not ask GitHub for the base (no network call in a gate that runs on every tool call), so it cannot tell a merge into main from a merge into a feature branch. Protect main on the server too.
